description: Kan-Agent official component catalog (HLD §4.6). Substrate data, not a tool: the single source of truth for official distribution URLs, versions, install roots and config placement. repo_fetch/install_audit resolve URLs from here and reject anything not in it (anti-URL-fabrication); sys_inspect lists installable components/versions read-only; the permission layer adjudicates URL legality from here. NOT derived from kan-linux's build system: that system runs at OS-build time against a rootfs being assembled, while this catalog describes installs on an already-installed user machine. Absorbs install-prebuilts.sh: its 8 components, version constants, URL patterns, /opt roots, extract layouts and setup_*_config placement live here as data.
principles: origin is mandatory and must be "official": third-party mirrors, CDN redirectors and auto-generated source snapshots are not catalog data.
url_pattern and versions are separate fields so a version bump changes only the version list, never the URL shape.
sha256 is optional: when absent, trust rests on the official-source allowlist plus human audit of the entry, not on a checksum. install_audit verifies a hash only when the entry carries one.
install_root is per source_type: binary class installs under /opt/<tool> (self-contained trees), source class deploys into /usr via the content-addressed store + symlink flip.
The model supplies only component and version. The catalog resolves everything else; a model-supplied URL is never accepted for source_type=binary.
image_class carries the install-prebuilts.sh split: in-image components ship with the OS and are updated in place, optional components are installed on demand.
deploy_profile carries each component's setup_*_config placement as data; atomic_deploy executes it and snapshots system files for rollback.
free_space_preflight_mb is the substrate disk preflight (about 10G, matching install-prebuilts.sh): enforced before fetch and before deploy.
